title: Controlled forms, uncontrolled inputs and the form libraries

videos.script:
A form is where a user hands your app something it has to trust. Today the planner gets its first one: a date, a number of minutes, and a button.

{{controlled}} You will write it controlled first, with React holding every keystroke. It works, and it happily accepts a session with no date at all.

{{uncontrolled}} Then uncontrolled, with the browser holding the values until submit, and the browser's own validation refusing what is wrong.

{{library}} Then React Hook Form and Zod. The install fails, for a reason buried in someone else's optional dependency, and you will read the error and choose a version that works.

{{errors}} And last, errors a screen reader can find. The field says it is invalid, the message is attached to it, and the focus goes there.
